latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of quicklrc-transcribe.

- Generate synced lyrics or subtitle files (LRC, SRT, WebVTT, ASS, TTML) using the QuickLRC API.
- Supports auto-transcription, force-alignment, word-level (karaoke) timing, and smart section labeling.
- Accepts any audio/video URL or YouTube link.
- Requires a QuickLRC API key for authentication.
- Returns plain text subtitle files; failed requests are not charged.
- Full API usage documentation and parameters included.
